name: @restate-agents/core
description: Durable Restate services for the reference agent runtime.

scripts.test:ptc: tsc -p test/ptc/tsconfig.json && node --import tsx --test test/ptc/*.test.ts test/ptc/*.test.mjs
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --sourcemap --platform=node --target=node22 --banner:js="import { createRequire as __restateCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __restateCreateRequire(import.meta.url); const __dirname = import.meta.dirname;" --outfile=dist/app.js
